battery.name: compare_v1
battery.description: 8 static-object prompts (blender / bpy) used to compare the harness loop against raw one-shot generation by strong models under ONE fixed judge.  Tiers: 2 easy, 3 medium, 3 hard.  must_have items become the fixed judge's acceptance checklist for EVERY arm (no plan-derived items, so harness and one-shot are judged alike).

prompts.prompt: a simple three-legged round wooden stool, 45 cm tall
must_have: three splayed legs of equal length

prompts.prompt: a desk lamp with a heavy round base, a single angled arm and a conical metal shade
must_have: conical shade at the top of the arm

prompts.prompt: a wooden dining chair with a gently curved backrest, a flat seat and four tapered legs
must_have: four tapered legs touching the ground
backrest visibly curved in plan view
back legs continue up into the backrest posts

prompts.prompt: a garden wheelbarrow with a sheet-metal tray, one front wheel, two straight handles and two rear legs
must_have: single front wheel with a hub
two parallel handles at the back
two rear legs reaching the ground

prompts.prompt: a home espresso machine with a boxy body, a portafilter group head at the front, a steam wand on the right side and a drip tray
must_have: group head with a portafilter handle at the front
steam wand on the right side
drip tray at the bottom front

prompts.prompt: a vintage bicycle with a diamond frame, two spoked wheels, handlebars, saddle, pedals with a chainring and a rear rack
must_have: diamond frame tubes connecting the wheels
chainring and pedals between the wheels

prompts.prompt: an acoustic guitar standing upright on a small floor stand, with a waisted body, a round sound hole, a fretted neck with a headstock and six tuning pegs
must_have: stand holding the guitar upright on the ground

prompts.prompt: a small wooden sailboat on a display cradle, with a hull, a keel, one mast with a boom and a triangular mainsail, a rudder and a tiller
must_have: rudder and tiller at the stern
cradle keeping the boat upright on the ground
